title: Notify the relocation or change of ownership of registered plant
summary: Learn the requirements and steps for notifying SafeWork NSW about a change in ownership or relocation of registered plant.
intro:
If the registration holder of an item of plant has changed, or a fixed item has been relocated, SafeWork NSW must be notified in writing within 14 days.

In the instance of a relocated item of plant, the item must have been inspected by a competent person and assessed as safe to operate.
who_can_apply: The registration holder must advise of the changes.
If there is a change of ownership, either the new or the previous owner must advise.
what_you_need: The PDF form: 'Notification of relocation or change of ownership of registered plant'
The registration number of the plant
The expiry date of the registration
The working location of the plant
Details of the new owner (if applicable)
Details of the previous owner (if applicable)
A completed design engineer's statement for tower crane foundations – PDF (if relocating a tower crane to a worksite)

how_to_steps.text: Email the form with any required supporting documentation using the details on the form.

faqs.q: How quickly must I notify SafeWork NSW of a change?
faqs.a: If the registration holder has changed, or a fixed item has been relocated, SafeWork NSW must be notified in writing within 14 days.

faqs.q: What must happen if the plant is relocated?
faqs.a: The relocated item of plant must have been inspected by a competent person and assessed as safe to operate.

faqs.q: Who needs to advise of these changes?
faqs.a: The registration holder must advise of the changes. If there is a change of ownership, either the new or the previous owner must also be notified.
